title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) PRISON STATISTICS - 1996 It would be seen that Madhya Pradesh leads with Rs.290.14 lakhs followed by Karnataka (Rs.271.35 lakhs) and West Bengal (185.12 lakhs) as Plan Expenditure under various Plan schemes. Delhi incurred only 75.44 lakhs expenditure in such schemes.
